digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler live-verification harness
propositions: The epic's headline AC is unmet because the live reconciler pass converged over an EMPTY harness instance, so a clean run proved nothing about data actually moving bidirectionally.

Live verification must run against a copy of the project's real ticket store, materialized by fetching the gitignored orphan 'tickets' branch and extracting into .tickets-tracker/, asserting local ticket count matches git ls-tree rather than a bare >0 floor.

Isolation must be asserted not assumed: a fresh git repo with NO remote (verified via git remote returning nothing), REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and no Cloud credentials — never asserting on sync.remote which defaults to origin regardless.

The store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* binding and snapshot artifacts by glob enumeration (including the .bak-retarget backup), asserted absent, because leftover bindings map to real production Jira keys and drive spurious deletion mutations.

A comprehensive suite of fourteen inbound and fourteen outbound DC-side mutations must each round-trip against a named per-mutation oracle, individually asserted, except set_parent's epic case which raises NotImplementedError asserted directly against the transport since the reconciler swallows the exception.

Pagination is a remote-side property not exercised by the store copy, so the suite must observe the server's effective page size and seed 2*observed+1 harness issues, polling the eventually-consistent search index before asserting full recovery.
